Rogers has served as CEO and Managing Director of ASX-listed Jupiter Mines

Before Jupiter, Rogers was CEO and Managing Director of Bis Industries, a leading provider of production services to the mining and industrial sectors across Australia and Indonesia, after joining the company in 2008.
COO Barry Palmer assumed the CEO role in January following the sudden departure of Joe Lambert after nearly two decades with the company.
